items.title: 52193_Jay McShann oral history interview
items.q: I didn't get a chance to catch Benny -- I caught Benny Moten one time. Was it Benny? I thought it was Benny because -- I do know this, that Jimmy Rushing was with the band. That's the reason I assumed it was Benny Moten's band.

ctx.x: That was Shawnee, Oklahoma. And we were playing there to an old ballroom that had been there for years. Benny Moten and all the guys used to play there, you

know? Bluebird Ballroom. And so we played there, I think it was either three or four nights a week and then sometimes we'd play a dance for one of those small towns or something like that and that went along up until some fellow came from Albuquerque, New Mexico, looking for a band, you know. Of course, --
